## Biography

I am a PhD Candidate in Business Analytics and Statistics at the Haslam College of Business, University of Tennessee, Knoxville, where I am advised by [Chuanren Liu](https://datalab.utk.edu/charles-liu/) and [Yuanyang Liu](https://sites.google.com/site/yuanyangliuhome). My research sits at the intersection of artificial intelligence and causal inference, using text mining and embedding methods to measure technology adoption and trace its effects on labor and financial outcomes. I convert unstructured patent and job-posting text into structured representations that feed econometric models estimating how AI exposure shapes skill value and firm capital investment.

**Research Fields**

- Causal Inference 
- Machine Learning & Representation Learning
- Natural Language Processing (NLP)
- Network Analysis

**Education**

- PhD, Business Analytics and Statistics — University of Tennessee, Knoxville (2023–Present)
- M.S., Finance and Technology — Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam (2020–2021)
- M.S., Applied Economics — Kansas State University (2017–2019)
- B.A., Applied Economics — Kansas State University (2011–2015)

**Advisors:** [Chuanren Liu](https://datalab.utk.edu/charles-liu/), [Yuanyang Liu](https://sites.google.com/site/yuanyangliuhome)

**Committee Members:** [Chuanren Liu](https://datalab.utk.edu/charles-liu/), [Yuanyang Liu](https://sites.google.com/site/yuanyangliuhome), Hao (Howard) Zhong, Matthew Henriksson

**Job Market:** I am on the 2026–2027 academic job market.
